   701→function buildIndividualTravelSegmentParams(
   702→  params: IndividualTravelSegmentParams,
   703→  finalResolution: string
   704→): Record<string, unknown> {
   705→  const state = buildSegmentState(params);
   706→  const orchestratorDetails = buildOrchestratorDetails(params, state, finalResolution);
   707→  const sourceSnapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params.originalParams);
   708→  const legacyContractTaskId = extractOrchestratorTaskIdParam(params.originalParams);
   709→  const legacyRunId = extractRunIdParam(params.originalParams);
   710→  const orchestratorTaskId = resolveSnapshotOrchestratorTaskId(sourceSnapshot)
   711→    ?? legacyContractTaskId
   712→    ?? asString(state.orchDetails.orchestrator_task_id)
   713→    ?? asString(state.orig.orchestrator_task_id_ref);
   714→  const runId = resolveSnapshotRunId(sourceSnapshot)
   715→    ?? legacyRunId
   716→    ?? asString(state.orchDetails.run_id)
   717→    ?? asString(state.orig.run_id);
   718→
   719→  const hasPairShotGenerationId = Boolean(
   720→    params.pair_shot_generation_id
   721→    || params.start_image_variant_id
   722→    || params.end_image_variant_id,
   723→  );
   724→  const segmentRegenerationMode = hasPairShotGenerationId
   725→    ? 'segment_regen_from_pair'
   726→    : 'segment_regen_from_order';
   727→  const generationRouting = params.child_generation_id
   728→    ? 'variant_child'
   729→    : 'child_generation';
   730→
   731→  const familyContract = buildIndividualSegmentFamilyContract({
   732→    segmentRegenerationMode,
   733→    generationRouting,
   734→    segmentIndex: params.segment_index,
   735→    hasEndImage: Boolean(params.end_image_url),
   736→    hasPairShotGenerationId,
   737→  });
   738→
   739→  const composedPayload = composeTaskFamilyPayload({
   740→    taskFamily: 'individual_travel_segment',
   741→    orchestratorDetails,
   742→    orchestrationInput: {
   743→      taskFamily: 'individual_travel_segment',
   744→      orchestratorTaskId,
   745→      runId,
   746→      parentGenerationId: params.parent_generation_id,
   747→      childGenerationId: params.child_generation_id,
   748→      childOrder: params.segment_index,
   749→      shotId: params.shot_id,
   750→      generationRouting,
   751→      siblingLookup: runId ? 'run_id' : 'orchestrator_task_id',
   752→      segmentRegenerationMode,
   753→    },
   754→    taskViewInput: {
   755→      inputImages: state.inputImages,
   756→      prompt: state.basePrompt,
   757→      enhancedPrompt: state.enhancedPrompt,
   758→      negativePrompt: state.negativePrompt,
   759→      modelName: state.modelName,
   760→      resolution: finalResolution,
   761→    },
   762→    familyContract,
   763→  });
   764→  const taskParams = {
   765→    ...buildTaskParamsPayload(params, state, finalResolution, orchestratorDetails),
   766→    ...composedPayload,
   767→  };
   768→  taskParams.individual_segment_params = buildIndividualSegmentParamsPayload(params, state);
   769→  return taskParams;
   770→}
   771→
   772→/**
   773→ * Creates an individual travel segment regeneration task
   774→ * 
   775→ * This creates a standalone task (visible in TasksPane) that regenerates
   776→ * a single segment and creates a variant on the parent generation when complete.
   777→ * The task params match the exact structure of travel_segment for GPU worker compatibility.
   778→ * 
   779→ * @param params - Individual travel segment parameters
   780→ * @returns Promise resolving to the created task
   781→ */
   782→export async function createIndividualTravelSegmentTask(params: IndividualTravelSegmentParams): Promise<TaskCreationResult> {
   783→  return runTaskCreationPipeline({
   784→    params,
   785→    context: 'IndividualTravelSegment',
   786→    validate: validateIndividualTravelSegmentParams,
   787→    buildTaskRequest: async (requestParams) => {
   788→      const supabase = getSupabaseClient();
   789→
   790→      const effectiveParentGenerationId = await ensureShotParentGenerationId({
   791→        projectId: requestParams.project_id,
   792→        shotId: requestParams.shot_id,
   793→        parentGenerationId: requestParams.parent_generation_id,
   794→        context: 'IndividualTravelSegment',
   795→      });
   796→
   797→      let effectiveChildGenerationId = requestParams.child_generation_id;
   798→
   799→      if (!effectiveChildGenerationId && effectiveParentGenerationId) {
   800→        if (requestParams.pair_shot_generation_id) {
   801→          const { data: childByPairId, error: pairIdError } = await supabase
   802→            .from('generations')
   803→            .select('id')
   804→            .eq('parent_generation_id', effectiveParentGenerationId)
   805→            .eq('pair_shot_generation_id', requestParams.pair_shot_generation_id)
   806→            .limit(1)
   807→            .maybeSingle();
   808→
   809→          if (pairIdError) {
   810→            throw new Error(
   811→              `IndividualTravelSegment.lookupChildByPairId failed: ${pairIdError.message}`,
   812→            );
   813→          }
   814→
   815→          if (childByPairId) {
   816→            effectiveChildGenerationId = childByPairId.id;
   817→          }
   818→        }
   819→
   820→        if (!effectiveChildGenerationId && requestParams.segment_index !== undefined && !requestParams.pair_shot_generation_id) {
   821→          const { data: childByOrder, error: orderError } = await supabase
   822→            .from('generations')
   823→            .select('id')
   824→            .eq('parent_generation_id', effectiveParentGenerationId)
   825→            .eq('child_order', requestParams.segment_index)
   826→            .limit(1)
   827→            .maybeSingle();
   828→
   829→          if (orderError) {
   830→            throw new Error(
   831→              `IndividualTravelSegment.lookupChildByOrder failed: ${orderError.message}`,
   832→            );
   833→          }
   834→
   835→          if (childByOrder) {
   836→            effectiveChildGenerationId = childByOrder.id;
   837→          }
   838→        }
   839→      }
   840→
   841→      const paramsWithIds = {
   842→        ...requestParams,
   843→        parent_generation_id: effectiveParentGenerationId,
   844→        child_generation_id: effectiveChildGenerationId,
   845→      };
   846→
   847→      const directResolution = asString(requestParams.parsed_resolution_wh);
   848→      const originalParams = toRecordOrEmpty(requestParams.originalParams);
   849→      const originalOrchestratorDetails = toRecordOrEmpty(originalParams.orchestrator_details);
   850→      const origResolutionValue =
   851→        originalParams.parsed_resolution_wh ?? originalOrchestratorDetails.parsed_resolution_wh;
   852→      const origResolution = directResolution
   853→        ?? (typeof origResolutionValue === 'string' ? origResolutionValue : undefined);
   854→      const { resolution: finalResolution } = await resolveProjectResolution(
   855→        requestParams.project_id,
   856→        origResolution,
   857→      );
   858→
   859→      const taskParams = buildIndividualTravelSegmentParams(paramsWithIds, finalResolution);
   860→
   861→      return composeTaskRequest({
   862→        source: requestParams,
   863→        taskType: 'individual_travel_segment',
   864→        params: taskParams,
   865→      });
   866→    },
   867→  });
   868→}
   869→
   870→// TaskValidationError is used internally - import from taskCreation.ts if needed externally
   871→

    85→
    86→export type ToolSettingsErrorCode =
    87→  | 'auth_required'
    88→  | 'cancelled'
    89→  | 'network'
    90→  | 'scope_fetch_failed'
    91→  | 'invalid_scope_identifier'
    92→  | 'unknown';
    93→
    94→interface ToolSettingsErrorOptions {
    95→  recoverable?: boolean;
    96→  cause?: unknown;
    97→  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
    98→}
    99→
   100→export class ToolSettingsError extends Error {
   101→  readonly code: ToolSettingsErrorCode;
   102→  readonly recoverable: boolean;
   103→  readonly metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
   104→  readonly cause?: unknown;
   105→
   106→  constructor(
   107→    code: ToolSettingsErrorCode,
   108→    message: string,
   109→    options: ToolSettingsErrorOptions = {},
   110→  ) {
   111→    super(message);
   112→    this.name = 'ToolSettingsError';
   113→    this.code = code;
   114→    this.recoverable = options.recoverable ?? false;
   115→    this.metadata = options.metadata;
   116→    this.cause = options.cause;
   117→  }
   118→}
   119→
   120→export function isToolSettingsError(error: unknown): error is ToolSettingsError {
   121→  return error instanceof ToolSettingsError;
   122→}
   123→
   124→export function classifyToolSettingsError(error: unknown): ToolSettingsError {
   125→  if (isToolSettingsError(error)) {
   126→    return error;
   127→  }
   128→
   129→  if (isCancellationError(error)) {
   130→    return new ToolSettingsError('cancelled', 'Request was cancelled', {
   131→      recoverable: true,
   132→      cause: error,
   133→    });
   134→  }
   135→
   136→  const message = getErrorMessage(error);
   137→  if (message.includes('Authentication required')) {
   138→    return new ToolSettingsError('auth_required', message, {
   139→      recoverable: false,
   140→      cause: error,
   141→    });
   142→  }
   143→
   144→  if (
   145→    message.includes('Failed to fetch')
   146→    || message.includes('ERR_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES')
   147→    || message.includes('Network connection issue')
   148→    || message.includes('Network exhaustion')
   149→  ) {
   150→    return new ToolSettingsError('network', message, {
   151→      recoverable: true,
   152→      cause: error,
   153→    });
   154→  }
   155→
   156→  return new ToolSettingsError('unknown', message, {
   157→    recoverable: false,
   158→    cause: error,
   159→  });
   160→}
   161→
   162→function toOperationFailure(error: ToolSettingsError): OperationFailure {
   163→  return operationFailure(error, {
   164→    policy: error.recoverable ? 'best_effort' : 'fail_closed',
   165→    recoverable: error.recoverable,
   166→    errorCode: error.code,
   167→    message: error.message,
   168→    cause: error.cause,
   169→  });
   170→}
   171→
   172→export function toToolSettingsErrorFromOperationFailure(failure: OperationFailure): ToolSettingsError {
   173→  const code = failure.errorCode as ToolSettingsErrorCode;
   174→  const normalizedCode: ToolSettingsErrorCode = (
   175→    code === 'auth_required'
   176→    || code === 'cancelled'
   177→    || code === 'network'
   178→    || code === 'scope_fetch_failed'
   179→    || code === 'invalid_scope_identifier'
   180→    || code === 'unknown'
   181→  ) ? code : 'unknown';
   182→
   183→  return new ToolSettingsError(normalizedCode, failure.message, {
   184→    recoverable: failure.recoverable,
   185→    cause: failure.cause ?? failure.error,
   186→  });
   187→}
   188→
   189→/** The wrapper format returned by fetchToolSettingsSupabase */
   190→export interface SettingsFetchResult<T = unknown> {
   191→  settings: T;
   192→  hasShotSettings: boolean;
   193→}
   194→
   195→// ============================================================================
   196→// Auth helpers
   197→// ============================================================================
   198→
   199→/**
   200→ * Get authenticated user ID without acquiring navigator.locks.
   201→ *
   202→ * Resolution order (all synchronous / lock-free):
   203→ *   1. In-memory cache (set by AuthContext via setCachedUserId)
   204→ *   2. localStorage session (same key Supabase uses; contains full user object)
   205→ *   3. null — user is genuinely signed out
   206→ *
   207→ * Previously this called getSession() / getUser() which both acquire a shared
   208→ * navigator.lock. During token refresh Supabase holds an EXCLUSIVE lock, so
   209→ * ALL shared-lock requests queue behind it — blocking for 600ms-16s. By reading
   210→ * the user ID from localStorage instead we avoid locks entirely. Token validity
   211→ * for actual data requests is handled by createSupabaseClient's cached token.
   212→ */
   213→export function getCachedUserId(): Promise<{ data: { user: { id: string } | null }; error: null }> {
   214→  // Check in-memory cache first
   215→  if (cachedUser && (Date.now() - cachedUserAt) < USER_CACHE_MS) {
   216→    return Promise.resolve({ data: { user: { id: cachedUser.id } }, error: null });
   217→  }
   218→
   219→  // Read from localStorage — synchronous, no navigator.locks, always fresh
   220→  const localUserId = readUserIdFromStorage();
   221→  if (localUserId) {
   222→    cachedUser = { id: localUserId };
   223→    cachedUserAt = Date.now();
   224→    return Promise.resolve({ data: { user: { id: localUserId } }, error: null });
   225→  }
   226→
   227→  // No session in storage — user is signed out
   228→  return Promise.resolve({ data: { user: null }, error: null });
   229→}
   230→
   231→// ============================================================================
   232→// Settings fetch helpers
   233→// ============================================================================
   234→
   235→type SettingsRow = { data: { settings: unknown } | null; error: unknown };
   236→
   237→function throwIfAborted(signal?: AbortSignal): void {
   238→  if (!signal?.aborted) {
   239→    return;
   240→  }
   241→
   242→  throw new ToolSettingsError('cancelled', 'Request was cancelled', {
   243→    recoverable: true,
   244→  });
   245→}
   246→
   247→type AbortableQuery<T> = {
   248→  abortSignal?: (signal: AbortSignal) => T;
   249→};
   250→
   251→function maybeAttachAbortSignal<T>(query: T, signal?: AbortSignal): T {
   252→  if (!signal) {
   253→    return query;
   254→  }
   255→
   256→  const abortable = query as AbortableQuery<T>;
   257→  if (typeof abortable.abortSignal === 'function') {
   258→    return abortable.abortSignal(signal);
   259→  }
   260→
   261→  return query;
   262→}
   263→
   264→async function raceWithAbort<T>(promise: Promise<T>, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<T> {
   265→  if (!signal) {
   266→    return promise;
   267→  }
   268→
   269→  throwIfAborted(signal);
   270→
   271→  return await new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
   272→    const onAbort = () => {
   273→      cleanup();
   274→      reject(new ToolSettingsError('cancelled', 'Request was cancelled', {
   275→        recoverable: true,
   276→      }));
   277→    };
   278→
   279→    const cleanup = () => {
   280→      signal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
   281→    };
   282→
   283→    signal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
   284→    promise.then(
   285→      (value) => {
   286→        cleanup();
   287→        resolve(value);
   288→      },
   289→      (error) => {
   290→        cleanup();
   291→        reject(error);
   292→      },
   293→    );
   294→  });
   295→}
   296→
   297→/** Fetch settings from all three scopes (user, project, shot) in parallel. */
   298→function fetchAllScopes(
   299→  supabaseClient: ReturnType<typeof getSupabaseClient>,
   300→  userId: string,
   301→  ctx: ToolSettingsContext,
   302→  signal?: AbortSignal,
   303→): Promise<[SettingsRow, SettingsRow, SettingsRow]> {
   304→  const userQuery = maybeAttachAbortSignal(
   305→    supabaseClient
   306→      .from('users')
   307→      .select('settings')
   308→      .eq('id', userId)
   309→      .maybeSingle(),
   310→    signal,
   311→  );
   312→
   313→  const projectQuery = ctx.projectId
   314→    ? maybeAttachAbortSignal(
   315→        supabaseClient
   316→          .from('projects')
   317→          .select('settings')
   318→          .eq('id', ctx.projectId)
   319→          .maybeSingle(),
   320→        signal,
   321→      )
   322→    : Promise.resolve({ data: null, error: null });
   323→
   324→  const shotQuery = ctx.shotId
   325→    ? maybeAttachAbortSignal(
   326→        supabaseClient
   327→          .from('shots')
   328→          .select('settings')
   329→          .eq('id', ctx.shotId)
   330→          .maybeSingle(),
   331→        signal,
   332→      )
   333→    : Promise.resolve({ data: null, error: null });
   334→
   335→  return Promise.all([
   336→    userQuery,
   337→    projectQuery,
   338→    shotQuery,
   339→  ]) as Promise<[SettingsRow, SettingsRow, SettingsRow]>;
   340→}
   341→
   342→/** Extract tool-specific settings from scope results and merge in priority order. */
   343→function extractAndMergeSettings(
   344→  userResult: SettingsRow,
   345→  projectResult: SettingsRow,
   346→  shotResult: SettingsRow,
   347→  toolId: string,
   348→  ctx: ToolSettingsContext,
   349→): SettingsFetchResult {
   350→  if (userResult.error) {
   351→    throw new ToolSettingsError(
   352→      'scope_fetch_failed',
   353→      `Failed to load user settings: ${getErrorMessage(userResult.error)}`,
   354→      { recoverable: true, cause: userResult.error, metadata: { scope: 'user' } },
   355→    );
   356→  }
   357→  if (ctx.projectId && projectResult.error) {
   358→    throw new ToolSettingsError(
   359→      'scope_fetch_failed',
   360→      `Failed to load project settings: ${getErrorMessage(projectResult.error)}`,
   361→      { recoverable: true, cause: projectResult.error, metadata: { scope: 'project', projectId: ctx.projectId } },
   362→    );
   363→  }
   364→  if (ctx.shotId && shotResult.error) {
   365→    throw new ToolSettingsError(
   366→      'scope_fetch_failed',
   367→      `Failed to load shot settings: ${getErrorMessage(shotResult.error)}`,
   368→      { recoverable: true, cause: shotResult.error, metadata: { scope: 'shot', shotId: ctx.shotId } },
   369→    );
   370→  }
   371→
   372→  const userSettingsData = userResult.data?.settings as Record<string, unknown> | null;
   373→  const projectSettingsData = projectResult.data?.settings as Record<string, unknown> | null;
   374→  const shotSettingsData = shotResult.data?.settings as Record<string, unknown> | null;
   375→  const userSettings = (userSettingsData?.[toolId] as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {};
   376→  const projectSettings = (projectSettingsData?.[toolId] as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {};
   377→  const shotSettings = (shotSettingsData?.[toolId] as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {};
   378→  const defaultSettings = (toolDefaultsRegistry[toolId] as Record<string, unknown> | undefined) ?? {};
   379→
   380→  const hasShotSettings = shotSettings && Object.keys(shotSettings).length > 0;
   381→
   382→  // Merge in priority order: defaults -> user -> project -> shot
   383→  const merged = deepMerge(
   384→    {},
   385→    defaultSettings,
   386→    userSettings,
   387→    projectSettings,
   388→    shotSettings
   389→  );
   390→
   391→  return { settings: merged, hasShotSettings };
   392→}
   393→
   394→// ============================================================================
   395→// Settings fetch
   396→// ============================================================================
   397→
   398→/**
   399→ * Fetch and merge tool settings from all scopes using direct Supabase calls.
   400→ *
   401→ * Pipeline: dedup → auth → fetchAllScopes → extractAndMerge.
   402→ * Uses single-flight deduplication for concurrent identical requests.
   403→ *
   404→ * @returns `{ settings, hasShotSettings }` wrapper
   405→ */
   406→export async function fetchToolSettingsSupabase(
   407→  toolId: string,
   408→  ctx: ToolSettingsContext,
   409→  signal?: AbortSignal
   410→): Promise<OperationResult<SettingsFetchResult>> {
   411→  try {
   412→    reportUnknownSettingsId(toolId);
   413→
   414→    // Check if request was cancelled before starting
   415→    if (signal?.aborted) {
   416→      return toOperationFailure(new ToolSettingsError('cancelled', 'Request was cancelled', {
   417→        recoverable: true,
   418→      }));
   419→    }
   420→
   421→    // Single-flight dedupe key for concurrent identical requests
   422→    const singleFlightKey = JSON.stringify({ toolId, projectId: ctx.projectId ?? null, shotId: ctx.shotId ?? null });
   423→    const existingPromise = inflightSettingsFetches.get(singleFlightKey);
   424→    if (existingPromise) {
   425→      const value = await raceWithAbort(existingPromise as Promise<SettingsFetchResult>, signal);
   426→      return operationSuccess(value);
   427→    }
   428→
   429→    const promise = (async (): Promise<SettingsFetchResult> => {
   430→      throwIfAborted(signal);
   431→
   432→      const { data: { user } } = await getCachedUserId();
   433→
   434→      if (!user) {
   435→        throw new ToolSettingsError('auth_required', 'Authentication required');
   436→      }
   437→
   438→      throwIfAborted(signal);
   439→
   440→      const supabaseClient = getSupabaseClient();
   441→      const [userResult, projectResult, shotResult] = await fetchAllScopes(supabaseClient, user.id, ctx, signal);
   442→      throwIfAborted(signal);
   443→      return extractAndMergeSettings(userResult, projectResult, shotResult, toolId, ctx);
   444→    })();
   445→
   446→    inflightSettingsFetches.set(singleFlightKey, promise);
   447→    // The .finally cleanup promise is intentionally not awaited or returned.
   448→    // Suppress its rejection to avoid unhandled rejection warnings — the original
   449→    // `promise` reference (returned below) handles propagation to the caller.
   450→    promise.finally(() => {
   451→      inflightSettingsFetches.delete(singleFlightKey);
   452→    }).catch(() => {});
   453→    const value = await raceWithAbort(promise, signal);
   454→    return operationSuccess(value);
   455→
   456→  } catch (error: unknown) {
   457→    if (isToolSettingsError(error) && error.code === 'cancelled') {
   458→      return toOperationFailure(error);
   459→    }
   460→    if (isCancellationError(error)) {
   461→      return toOperationFailure(new ToolSettingsError('cancelled', 'Request was cancelled', {
   462→        recoverable: true,
   463→        cause: error,
   464→      }));
   465→    }
   466→    // Build context info without calling getSession() — can block during token refresh
   467→    const errorMsg = getErrorMessage(error);
   468→    const contextInfo = {
   469→      visibilityState: typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document.visibilityState : 'unknown',
   470→      hidden: typeof document !== 'undefined' ? document.hidden : false,
   471→      online: typeof navigator !== 'undefined' ? navigator.onLine : true,
   472→    };
   473→
   474→    if (errorMsg.includes('Auth timeout') || errorMsg.includes('Auth request was cancelled')) {
   475→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   476→        context: 'fetchToolSettingsSupabase.authTimeout',
   477→        showToast: false,
   478→        logData: contextInfo,
   479→      });
   480→      return toOperationFailure(new ToolSettingsError(
   481→        'network',
   482→        'Authentication check timed out. Please retry.',
   483→        {
   484→          recoverable: true,
   485→          cause: error,
   486→          metadata: { ...contextInfo, reason: 'auth_timeout' },
   487→        },
   488→      ));
   489→    }
   490→
   491→    if (errorMsg.includes('Failed to fetch')) {
   492→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'fetchToolSettingsSupabase.network', showToast: false, logData: contextInfo });
   493→      return toOperationFailure(new ToolSettingsError(
   494→        'network',
   495→        'Network connection issue. Please check your internet connection.',
   496→        {
   497→          recoverable: true,
   498→          cause: error,
   499→          metadata: contextInfo,
   500→        },
   501→      ));
   502→    }
   503→
   504→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'fetchToolSettingsSupabase', showToast: false, logData: contextInfo });
   505→    return toOperationFailure(classifyToolSettingsError(error));
   506→  }
   507→}
   508→
   509→/**
   510→ * Fetch tool settings and throw `ToolSettingsError` on failure.
   511→ *
   512→ * Use this from hook boundaries that already model errors as thrown exceptions
   513→ * (for example React Query query functions and mutation pipelines) so read/write
   514→ * settings flows share the same error contract.
   515→ */
   516→export async function fetchToolSettingsSupabaseOrThrow(
   517→  toolId: string,
   518→  ctx: ToolSettingsContext,
   519→  signal?: AbortSignal,
   520→): Promise<SettingsFetchResult> {
   521→  const result = await fetchToolSettingsSupabase(toolId, ctx, signal);
   522→  if (!result.ok) {
   523→    throw toToolSettingsErrorFromOperationFailure(result);
   524→  }
   525→  return result.value;
   526→}

   199→    // Check authentication
   200→    try {
   201→      const { data: { session }, error: sessionError } = await fetchRealtimeSession();
   202→      if (sessionError || !session?.user) {
   203→        const errorMsg = sessionError?.message || 'No valid session';
   204→        normalizeAndPresentError(new Error(errorMsg), {
   205→          context: 'RealtimeConnection.authCheck',
   206→          showToast: false,
   207→          logData: {
   208→            hasSession: !!session,
   209→            hasUser: !!session?.user,
   210→          },
   211→        });
   212→        this.setState({
   213→          status: 'failed',
   214→          error: errorMsg,
   215→        });
   216→        dataFreshnessManager.onRealtimeStatusChange('error', errorMsg);
   217→        return false;
   218→      }
   219→
   220→      // Set auth token for realtime
   221→      if (session.access_token) {
   222→        setRealtimeAuthToken(session.access_token);
   223→      }
   224→    } catch (error) {
   225→      const errorMsg = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Auth check failed';
   226→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   227→        context: 'RealtimeConnection.authSessionFetch',
   228→        showToast: false,
   229→      });
   230→      this.setState({
   231→        status: 'failed',
   232→        error: errorMsg,
   233→      });
   234→      dataFreshnessManager.onRealtimeStatusChange('error', errorMsg);
   235→      return false;
   236→    }
   237→
   238→    if (!this.isCurrentConnectAttempt(connectSequence)) {
   239→      return false;
   240→    }
   241→
   242→    // Create and subscribe to channel
   243→    const topic = `task-updates:${projectId}`;
   244→    const channel = createRealtimeChannel(topic);
   245→    if (!this.isCurrentConnectAttempt(connectSequence)) {
   246→      void channel.unsubscribe().catch(() => {
   247→        // Ignore cleanup errors for stale attempts
   248→      });
   249→      return false;
   250→    }
   251→    this.channel = channel;
   252→
   253→    // Set up event handlers for ALL tables
   254→    this.setupEventHandlers(projectId, channel);
   255→
   256→    // Subscribe with timeout
   257→    return new Promise((resolve) => {
   258→      let settled = false;
   259→      const settle = (result: boolean) => {
   260→        if (settled) {
   261→          return;
   262→        }
   263→        settled = true;
   264→        resolve(result);
   265→      };
   266→
   267→      const subscribeTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
   268→        if (this.subscribeTimeout === subscribeTimeout) {
   269→          this.subscribeTimeout = null;
   270→        }
   271→        if (!this.isCurrentConnectAttempt(connectSequence)) {
   272→          settle(false);
   273→          return;
   274→        }
   275→        this.handleSubscribeFailure('Timeout', projectId, connectSequence);
   276→        settle(false);
   277→      }, this.config.subscribeTimeout);
   278→      this.subscribeTimeout = subscribeTimeout;
   279→
   280→      channel.subscribe((status: string) => {
   281→        if (!this.isCurrentConnectAttempt(connectSequence)) {
   282→          void channel.unsubscribe().catch(() => {
   283→            // Ignore cleanup errors for stale callbacks
   284→          });
   285→          return;
   286→        }
   287→
   288→        if (this.subscribeTimeout === subscribeTimeout) {
   289→          clearTimeout(subscribeTimeout);
   290→          this.subscribeTimeout = null;
   291→        }
   292→
   293→        if (status === 'SUBSCRIBED') {
   294→          this.setState({
   295→            status: 'connected',
   296→            error: null,
   297→            reconnectAttempt: 0,
   298→            nextRetryAt: null,
   299→          });
   300→          dataFreshnessManager.onRealtimeStatusChange('connected', 'Connected');
   301→          settle(true);
   302→        } else if (status === 'CHANNEL_ERROR' || status === 'TIMED_OUT') {
   303→          this.handleSubscribeFailure(status, projectId, connectSequence);
   304→          settle(false);
   305→        }
   306→      });
   307→    });
   308→  }
   309→
   310→  private setupEventHandlers(projectId: string, channel: RealtimeChannel): void {
   311→
   312→    // Tasks: INSERT and UPDATE
   313→    channel
   314→      .on('postgres_changes',
   315→        { event: 'INSERT', schema: 'public', table: 'tasks', filter: `project_id=eq.${projectId}` },
   316→        (payload) => this.emitEvent('tasks', 'INSERT', payload.new, null)
   317→      )
   318→      .on('postgres_changes',
   319→        { event: 'UPDATE', schema: 'public', table: 'tasks', filter: `project_id=eq.${projectId}` },
   320→        (payload) => this.emitEvent('tasks', 'UPDATE', payload.new, payload.old)
   321→      );
   322→
   323→    // Generations: INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE
   324→    channel
   325→      .on('postgres_changes',
   326→        { event: 'INSERT', schema: 'public', table: 'generations', filter: `project_id=eq.${projectId}` },
   327→        (payload) => this.emitEvent('generations', 'INSERT', payload.new, null)
   328→      )
   329→      .on('postgres_changes',
   330→        { event: 'UPDATE', schema: 'public', table: 'generations', filter: `project_id=eq.${projectId}` },
   331→        (payload) => this.emitEvent('generations', 'UPDATE', payload.new, payload.old)
   332→      )
   333→      .on('postgres_changes',
   334→        { event: 'DELETE', schema: 'public', table: 'generations', filter: `project_id=eq.${projectId}` },
   335→        (payload) => this.emitEvent('generations', 'DELETE', payload.old, null)
   336→      );
   337→
   338→    // Shot generations: INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE (no project filter - cross-project table)
   339→    channel
   340→      .on('postgres_changes',
   341→        { event: 'INSERT', schema: 'public', table: 'shot_generations' },
   342→        (payload) => this.emitEvent('shot_generations', 'INSERT', payload.new, null)
   343→      )
   344→      .on('postgres_changes',
   345→        { event: 'UPDATE', schema: 'public', table: 'shot_generations' },
   346→        (payload) => this.emitEvent('shot_generations', 'UPDATE', payload.new, payload.old)
   347→      )
   348→      .on('postgres_changes',
   349→        { event: 'DELETE', schema: 'public', table: 'shot_generations' },
   350→        (payload) => this.emitEvent('shot_generations', 'DELETE', payload.old, null)
   351→      );
   352→
   353→    // Variants: INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE (no project filter - cross-project table)
   354→    channel
   355→      .on('postgres_changes',
   356→        { event: 'INSERT', schema: 'public', table: 'generation_variants' },
   357→        (payload) => this.emitEvent('generation_variants', 'INSERT', payload.new, null)
   358→      )
   359→      .on('postgres_changes',
   360→        { event: 'UPDATE', schema: 'public', table: 'generation_variants' },
   361→        (payload) => this.emitEvent('generation_variants', 'UPDATE', payload.new, payload.old)
   362→      )
   363→      .on('postgres_changes',
   364→        { event: 'DELETE', schema: 'public', table: 'generation_variants' },
   365→        (payload) => this.emitEvent('generation_variants', 'DELETE', payload.old, null)
   366→      );
   367→  }
   368→
   369→  private emitEvent(
   370→    table: DatabaseTable,
   371→    eventType: DatabaseEventType,
   372→    newRecord: unknown,
   373→    oldRecord: unknown
   374→  ): void {
   375→    const event: RawDatabaseEvent = {
   376→      table,
   377→      eventType,
   378→      new: newRecord as Record<string, unknown>,
   379→      old: oldRecord as Partial<Record<string, unknown>> | null,
   380→      receivedAt: Date.now(),
   381→    };
   382→
   383→    this.eventCallbacks.forEach((callback) => {
   384→      try {
   385→        callback(event);
   386→      } catch (error) {
   387→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'RealtimeConnection.eventCallback', showToast: false });
   388→      }
   389→    });
   390→  }
   391→
   392→  // ===========================================================================
   393→  // Private: Reconnection Logic
   394→  // ===========================================================================
   395→
   396→  private handleSubscribeFailure(reason: string, projectId: string, connectSequence: number): void {
   397→    if (!this.isCurrentConnectAttempt(connectSequence)) {
   398→      return;
   399→    }
   400→
   401→    const attempt = this.state.reconnectAttempt + 1;
   402→    const isExhausted = attempt > this.config.maxReconnectAttempts;
   403→
   404→    if (isExhausted) {
   405→      normalizeAndPresentError(new Error('Max reconnect attempts reached'), {
   406→        context: 'RealtimeConnection.handleSubscribeFailure',
   407→        showToast: false,
   408→        logData: { reason, attempt, maxReconnectAttempts: this.config.maxReconnectAttempts },
   409→      });
   410→      this.setState({
   411→        status: 'failed',
   412→        error: `Connection failed after ${this.config.maxReconnectAttempts} attempts: ${reason}`,
   413→        reconnectAttempt: attempt,
   414→        nextRetryAt: null,
   415→      });
   416→      dataFreshnessManager.onRealtimeStatusChange('error', 'Max reconnect attempts reached');
   417→    } else {
   418→      const delay = Math.min(
   419→        this.config.baseReconnectDelay * Math.pow(2, attempt - 1),
   420→        this.config.maxReconnectDelay
   421→      );
   422→      const nextRetryAt = Date.now() + delay;
   423→
   424→      console.warn(
   425→        `[RealtimeConnection] Subscribe failed: ${reason}. ` +
   426→        `Retrying in ${delay}ms (attempt ${attempt}/${this.config.maxReconnectAttempts})`
   427→      );
   428→
   429→      this.setState({
   430→        status: 'reconnecting',
   431→        error: reason,
   432→        reconnectAttempt: attempt,
   433→        nextRetryAt,
   434→      });
   435→      dataFreshnessManager.onRealtimeStatusChange('error', `Reconnecting: ${reason}`);
   436→
   437→      this.scheduleReconnect(projectId, delay, connectSequence);
   438→    }
   439→  }
   440→
   441→  private scheduleReconnect(projectId: string, delay: number, failedConnectSequence: number): void {
   442→    this.clearTimeouts();
   443→
   444→    this.reconnectTimeout = setTimeout(async () => {
   445→      this.reconnectTimeout = null;
   446→      if (!this.isCurrentConnectAttempt(failedConnectSequence)) {
   447→        return;
   448→      }
   449→
   450→      // Clean up old channel before reconnecting
   451→      if (this.channel) {
   452→        try {
   453→          await this.channel.unsubscribe();
   454→        } catch {
   455→          // Ignore
   456→        }
   457→        this.channel = null;
   458→      }
   459→
   460→      await this.startConnect(projectId);
   461→      // If failed, doConnect will call handleSubscribeFailure which schedules next retry
   462→    }, delay);
   463→  }
   464→
   465→  private handleAuthHeal = (): void => {
   466→
   467→    // Only attempt reconnect if we're in a recoverable state
   468→    if (
   469→      this.state.projectId &&
   470→      (this.state.status === 'reconnecting' || this.state.status === 'failed')
   471→    ) {
   472→      // Reset attempt count on auth heal (fresh start)
   473→      this.setState({ reconnectAttempt: 0 });
   474→      void this.startConnect(this.state.projectId);
   475→    }
   476→  };
   477→
   478→  // ===========================================================================
   479→  // Private: State Management
   480→  // ===========================================================================
   481→
   482→  private setState(updates: Partial<ConnectionState>): void {
   483→    const prevStatus = this.state.status;
   484→
   485→    this.state = {
   486→      ...this.state,
   487→      ...updates,
   488→      statusChangedAt: updates.status && updates.status !== prevStatus
   489→        ? Date.now()
   490→        : this.state.statusChangedAt,
   491→    };
   492→
   493→    // Notify callbacks
   494→    const snapshot = this.getState();
   495→    this.statusCallbacks.forEach((callback) => {
   496→      try {
   497→        callback(snapshot);
   498→      } catch (error) {
   499→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'RealtimeConnection.statusCallback', showToast: false });
   500→      }
   501→    });
   502→  }
   503→
   504→  private clearTimeouts(): void {
   505→    if (this.reconnectTimeout) {
   506→      clearTimeout(this.reconnectTimeout);
   507→      this.reconnectTimeout = null;
   508→    }
   509→    if (this.subscribeTimeout) {
   510→      clearTimeout(this.subscribeTimeout);
   511→      this.subscribeTimeout = null;
   512→    }
   513→  }
   514→}
   515→
   516→// Singleton instance
   517→export const realtimeConnection = new RealtimeConnection();
   518→

   434→export function useInlineEditState(
   435→  media: GenerationRow,
   436→  onNavigateToGeneration?: (generationId: string) => Promise<void>,
   437→): InlineEditStateResult {
   438→  const env = useInlineEditEnvironment(media);
   439→  const persistence = useInlineEditPersistence(env.actualGenerationId, env.selectedProjectId);
   440→  const activeVariant = persistence.variants.activeVariant;
   441→  const effectiveImageUrl = activeVariant?.location || env.effectiveImageUrl;
   442→
   443→  useEffect(() => {
   444→    env.setUpscaleActiveVariant(activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id);
   445→  }, [env, activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id]);
   446→
   447→  const { data: availableLoras } = usePublicLoras();
   448→  const { inpainting, magic } = useInlineEditInpaintingAndMagic(media, env, persistence);
   449→  const reposition = useInlineEditReposition(media, env, inpainting, persistence);
   450→  const img2img = useInlineEditImg2Img(media, env, persistence, availableLoras);
   451→
   452→  useInlineEditSettingsSync(env.actualGenerationId, persistence.editSettings, inpainting);
   453→
   454→  const { sourceGenerationData } = useSourceGeneration({
   455→    media,
   456→    onOpenExternalGeneration: onNavigateToGeneration
   457→      ? async (id) => onNavigateToGeneration(id)
   458→      : undefined,
   459→  });
   460→
   461→  const starToggle = useStarToggle({ media });
   462→
   463→  const handleDownload = async () => {
   464→    await downloadMedia(effectiveImageUrl, media.id, env.isVideo, media.contentType);
   465→  };
   466→
   467→  const {
   468→    inpaintingState,
   469→    transformState,
   470→    generationState,
   471→    imageEditValue,
   472→  } = buildInlineEditStateModels({
   473→    env,
   474→    persistence,
   475→    inpainting,
   476→    magic,
   477→    reposition,
   478→    img2img,
   479→    starToggle,
   480→    handleDownload,
   481→  });
   482→
   483→  return {
   484→    media,
   485→    canvasEnvironment: {
   486→      isMobile: env.isMobile,
   487→      selectedProjectId: env.selectedProjectId,
   488→      isCloudMode: env.isCloudMode,
   489→      isVideo: env.isVideo,
   490→      imageContainerRef: env.imageContainerRef,
   491→      effectiveImageUrl,
   492→      imageDimensions: env.imageDimensions,
   493→      setImageDimensions: env.setImageDimensions,
   494→      isUpscaling: env.isUpscaling,
   495→      handleUpscale: env.handleUpscale,
   496→    },
   497→    inpaintingState,
   498→    transformState,
   499→    generationState,
   500→    variants: {
   501→      variants: persistence.variants.variants,
   502→      activeVariant: persistence.variants.activeVariant,
   503→      isLoading: persistence.variants.isLoading,
   504→      setActiveVariantId: persistence.variants.setActiveVariantId,
   505→      setPrimaryVariant: persistence.variants.setPrimaryVariant,
   506→      deleteVariant: persistence.variants.deleteVariant,
   507→    },
   508→    sourceGenerationData,
   509→    availableLoras,
   510→    imageEditValue,
   511→  } satisfies InlineEditStateResult;
   512→}

     2→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     3→import type { Database } from '@/integrations/supabase/types';
     4→import {

     8→import { fetchWithTimeout } from './fetchWithTimeout';
     9→import { readAccessTokenFromStorage } from '@/shared/lib/supabaseSession';
    10→
    11→const REALTIME_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS = 30_000;
    12→const REALTIME_MAX_RECONNECT_DELAY_MS = 10_000;
    13→
    14→export function createSupabaseClient() {
    15→  try {
    16→    // Cache the access token to avoid navigator.locks contention.
    17→    // Every supabase.rpc()/from() call normally goes through fetchWithAuth →
    18→    // _getAccessToken() → GoTrueClient.getSession() → _acquireLock(-1) →
    19→    // navigator.locks (exclusive). When the lock is held by a concurrent token
    20→    // refresh, ALL data requests queue indefinitely — blocking timeline drag RPCs
    21→    // for 8+ seconds even when the DB responds in 60ms.
    22→    //
    23→    // Fix: replace PostgrestClient.fetch (a public property, read dynamically on
    24→    // every from()/rpc() call) with a version that injects the cached token
    25→    // directly, bypassing getSession/navigator.locks entirely for data requests.
    26→    // Auth operations (supabase.auth.*) are unaffected.
    27→    let cachedToken: string | null = readAccessTokenFromStorage();
    28→
    29→    const url = getSupabaseUrl();
    30→    const [REDACTED]();
    31→
    32→    const client = createClient<Database>(url, key, {
    33→      auth: {
    34→        autoRefreshToken: true,
    35→        persistSession: true,
    36→        detectSessionInUrl: true,
    37→      },
    38→      realtime: {
    39→        params: { eventsPerSecond: 10 },
    40→        heartbeatIntervalMs: REALTIME_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS,
    41→        reconnectAfterMs: (tries: number) => Math.min(tries * 1000, REALTIME_MAX_RECONNECT_DELAY_MS),
    42→      },
    43→      global: {
    44→        fetch: fetchWithTimeout,
    45→      },
    46→      db: { schema: 'public' },
    47→    });
    48→
    49→    // Replace PostgrestClient.fetch to use the cached token.
    50→    // PostgrestClient reads this.fetch on each from()/rpc() call, so the
    51→    // replacement takes effect immediately without recreating any clients.
    52→    const dataFetch = async (input: RequestInfo | URL, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> => {
    53→      const headers = new Headers(init.headers ?? {});
    54→      if (!headers.has('apikey')) headers.set('apikey', key);
    55→      if (!headers.has('Authorization')) {
    56→        headers.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${cachedToken ?? key}`);
    57→      }
    58→      return fetchWithTimeout(input as Parameters<typeof fetchWithTimeout>[0], { ...init, headers });
    59→    };
    60→    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
    61→    (client as unknown as { rest: { fetch: typeof dataFetch } }).rest.fetch = dataFetch;
    62→
    63→    // Keep the cached token in sync with auth state changes.
    64→    client.auth.onAuthStateChange((_event, session) => {
    65→      cachedToken = session?.access_token ?? null;
    66→    });
    67→
    68→    return client;
    69→  } catch (error: unknown) {
    70→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'SupabaseClient', showToast: false });
    71→    throw error;
    72→  }
    73→}
    74→

1→/**
     2→ * Shared download logic for ImageLightbox and VideoLightbox
     3→ *

     5→ * extracts prompt for filename, and delegates to downloadMedia.

     7→
     8→import type { GenerationVariant } from '@/shared/hooks/useVariants';

    11→import { downloadMedia } from '@/shared/lib/media/downloadMedia';
    12→
    13→interface LightboxDownloadOptions {
    14→  /** Ref to the variant the user intends to download (synchronous, avoids race condition) */
    15→  intendedVariantId: string | null;
    16→  /** All loaded variants */
    17→  variants: GenerationVariant[];
    18→  /** Fallback URL when no variant matches */
    19→  fallbackUrl: string;
    20→  /** The media object for id, metadata, params, contentType */
    21→  media: GenerationRow;
    22→  /** Whether this is a video download */
    23→  isVideo: boolean;
    24→  /** Called with true/false to manage download loading state */
    25→  setIsDownloading: (v: boolean) => void;
    26→}
    27→
    28→/**
    29→ * Execute a lightbox download with variant resolution and prompt-based filename.
    30→ */
    31→export async function handleLightboxDownload({
    32→  intendedVariantId,
    33→  variants,
    34→  fallbackUrl,
    35→  media,
    36→  isVideo,
    37→  setIsDownloading,
    38→}: LightboxDownloadOptions): Promise<void> {
    39→  let urlToDownload: string | undefined;
    40→
    41→  if (intendedVariantId && variants.length > 0) {
    42→    const intendedVariant = variants.find((v) => v.id === intendedVariantId);
    43→    if (intendedVariant?.location) {
    44→      urlToDownload = intendedVariant.location;
    45→    }
    46→  }
    47→
    48→  if (!urlToDownload) {
    49→    urlToDownload = fallbackUrl;
    50→  }
    51→
    52→  if (!urlToDownload) return;
    53→
    54→  setIsDownloading(true);
    55→  try {
    56→    const segmentOverrides = readSegmentOverrides(media.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | null);
    57→    const prompt = media.params?.prompt ||
    58→                   (media.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.enhanced_prompt as string | undefined ||
    59→                   segmentOverrides.prompt ||
    60→                   (media.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.prompt as string | undefined;
    61→    await downloadMedia(urlToDownload, media.id, isVideo, media.contentType, prompt);
    62→  } finally {
    63→    setIsDownloading(false);
    64→  }
    65→}

1→/**
     2→ * Best-effort clipboard write that never throws.
     3→ * Returns true when the write succeeds.
     4→ */
     5→export async function writeClipboardTextSafe(
     6→  text: string,
     7→  options: { allowExecCommandFallback?: boolean } = {},
     8→): Promise<boolean> {
     9→  if (!text) {
    10→    return false;
    11→  }
    12→
    13→  if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.clipboard?.writeText) {
    14→    try {
    15→      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    16→      return true;
    17→    } catch {
    18→      // fall through to optional fallback
    19→    }
    20→  }
    21→
    22→  if (!options.allowExecCommandFallback || typeof document === 'undefined') {
    23→    return false;
    24→  }
    25→
    26→  let textarea: HTMLTextAreaElement | null = null;
    27→  try {
    28→    textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
    29→    textarea.value = text;
    30→    textarea.style.position = 'fixed';
    31→    textarea.style.left = '-9999px';
    32→    document.body.appendChild(textarea);
    33→    textarea.select();
    34→    return document.execCommand('copy') === true;
    35→  } catch {
    36→    return false;
    37→  } finally {
    38→    if (textarea?.parentNode) {
    39→      textarea.parentNode.removeChild(textarea);
    40→    }
    41→  }
    42→}
    43→

    32→export async function preloadGenerationTaskMappings(

    47→
    48→    const mappings = await getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations(batch, { projectId });
    49→    let reportedBatchQueryFailure = false;
    50→

    53→    batch.forEach((generationId) => {

    58→        cacheEntry,

    62→        reportedBatchQueryFailure = true;

    65→          showToast: false,
    66→        });
    67→      }

    73→            const { data, error } = await supabase

    12→/**
    13→ * Calls a Supabase edge function with a client-side timeout and abort propagation.
    14→ * Reads the access token directly from localStorage to avoid navigator.locks contention.
    15→ * Ensures long-running invocations do not stall the UI indefinitely.
    16→ */
    17→export async function invokeWithTimeout<T = unknown>(functionName: string, options: InvokeOptions = {}): Promise<T> {
    18→  const { body, headers, timeoutMs = 20000, signal } = options;
    19→
    20→  const controller = new AbortController();
    21→  let didTimeout = false;
    22→  const signals: AbortSignal[] = [];
    23→  if (signal) signals.push(signal);
    24→  signals.push(controller.signal);
    25→
    26→  // Compose signals: abort if any provided signal aborts
    27→  const composed = new AbortController();
    28→  const onAbort = () => composed.abort();
    29→  signals.forEach(s => {
    30→    if (s.aborted) composed.abort();
    31→    else s.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    32→  });
    33→
    34→  const tid = setTimeout(() => {
    35→    didTimeout = true;
    36→    try { controller.abort(); } catch { /* intentionally ignored */ }
    37→  }, timeoutMs);
    38→
    39→  try {
    40→    const [REDACTED]();
    41→    const supabaseUrl = getSupabaseUrl();
    42→    const [REDACTED]();
    43→    const url = `${supabaseUrl}/functions/v1/${functionName}`;
    44→    const response = await fetch(url, {
    45→      method: 'POST',
    46→      headers: {
    47→        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    48→        Authorization: `Bearer ${accessToken ?? anonKey}`,
    49→        apikey: anonKey,
    50→        ...(headers ?? {}),
    51→      },
    52→      body: body !== undefined ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
    53→      signal: composed.signal,
    54→    });
    55→
    56→    if (!response.ok) {
    57→      const errorText = await response.text().catch(() => '');
    58→      throw new Error(errorText || `Function ${functionName} failed with status ${response.status}`);
    59→    }
    60→
    61→    const data = await response.json() as T;
    62→    return data;
    63→  } catch (err: unknown) {
    64→    if (isAbortError(err)) {
    65→      if (didTimeout) {
    66→        throw new Error(`Function ${functionName} timed out after ${timeoutMs}ms`);
    67→      }
    68→      throw err;
    69→    }
    70→    throw err;
    71→  } finally {
    72→    clearTimeout(tid);
    73→    signals.forEach(s => s.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort));
    74→  }

    10→
    11→/**
    12→ * Returns the existing parent generation ID for a shot, or creates one if missing.
    13→ * Never replaces an existing parent generation.
    14→ */
    15→export async function ensureShotParentGenerationId({
    16→  projectId,
    17→  shotId,

    20→}: EnsureShotParentGenerationInput): Promise<string> {

    31→  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('ensure_shot_parent_generation', {

     2→ * LineageGifModal
     3→ *
     4→ * Modal component that displays the lineage chain as a grid of images

     8→import React, { useState } from 'react';
     9→import { Download, Loader2, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';

    11→import { Progress } from '@/shared/components/ui/progress';

    14→import { GIFEncoder, quantize, applyPalette } from 'gifenc';
    15→
    16→interface CreateGifProgress {
    17→  stage: 'loading' | 'encoding' | 'complete';
    18→  current: number;
    19→  total: number;
    20→  message: string;
    21→}
    22→
    23→function loadImageFromBlobUrl(blobUrl: string): Promise<HTMLImageElement> {
    24→  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    25→    const img = new Image();
    26→    img.onload = () => resolve(img);
    27→    img.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to load image from blob'));
    28→    img.src = blobUrl;
    29→  });
    30→}
    31→
    32→async function createLineageGif(
    33→  imageUrls: string[],
    34→  options: { frameDelay?: number; width?: number } = {},
    35→  onProgress?: (progress: CreateGifProgress) => void
    36→): Promise<Blob> {
    37→  const { frameDelay = 800, width = 512 } = options;
    38→  if (imageUrls.length === 0) throw new Error('No images provided for GIF creation');
    39→
    40→  onProgress?.({ stage: 'loading', current: 0, total: imageUrls.length, message: 'Loading images...' });
    41→
    42→  const images: HTMLImageElement[] = [];
    43→  const blobUrls: string[] = [];
    44→
    45→  for (let i = 0; i < imageUrls.length; i++) {
    46→    try {
    47→      const response = await fetch(imageUrls[i]);
    48→      if (!response.ok) continue;
    49→      const blob = await response.blob();
    50→      const blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    51→      blobUrls.push(blobUrl);
    52→      const img = await loadImageFromBlobUrl(blobUrl);
    53→      images.push(img);
    54→      onProgress?.({ stage: 'loading', current: i + 1, total: imageUrls.length, message: `Loading images ${i + 1}/${imageUrls.length}` });
    55→    } catch { /* Skip failed images */ }
    56→  }
    57→
    58→  if (images.length === 0) {
    59→    blobUrls.forEach(url => URL.revokeObjectURL(url));
    60→    throw new Error('No images could be loaded');
    61→  }
    62→
    63→  const firstImage = images[0];
    64→  const aspectRatio = firstImage.width / firstImage.height;
    65→  const height = Math.round(width / aspectRatio);
    66→
    67→  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    68→  canvas.width = width;
    69→  canvas.height = height;
    70→  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
    71→
    72→  if (!ctx) {
    73→    blobUrls.forEach(url => URL.revokeObjectURL(url));
    74→    throw new Error('Could not get canvas context');
    75→  }
    76→
    77→  const gif = GIFEncoder();
    78→  onProgress?.({ stage: 'encoding', current: 0, total: images.length, message: 'Encoding frames...' });
    79→
    80→  for (let i = 0; i < images.length; i++) {
    81→    const img = images[i];
    82→    ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
    83→    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
    84→
    85→    const imgAspect = img.width / img.height;
    86→    const targetAspect = width / height;
    87→    let drawWidth: number, drawHeight: number, drawX: number, drawY: number;
    88→
    89→    if (imgAspect > targetAspect) {
    90→      drawWidth = width;
    91→      drawHeight = width / imgAspect;
    92→      drawX = 0;
    93→      drawY = (height - drawHeight) / 2;
    94→    } else {
    95→      drawHeight = height;
    96→      drawWidth = height * imgAspect;
    97→      drawX = (width - drawWidth) / 2;
    98→      drawY = 0;
    99→    }
   100→
   101→    ctx.drawImage(img, drawX, drawY, drawWidth, drawHeight);
   102→    const imageData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, width, height);
   103→    const rgbaPixels = new Uint8Array(imageData.data);
   104→    const palette = quantize(rgbaPixels, 256, { format: 'rgba4444' });
   105→    const indexedPixels = applyPalette(rgbaPixels, palette);
   106→    gif.writeFrame(indexedPixels, width, height, { palette, delay: frameDelay / 10 });
   107→    onProgress?.({ stage: 'encoding', current: i + 1, total: images.length, message: `Encoding frames ${i + 1}/${images.length}` });
   108→  }
   109→
   110→  blobUrls.forEach(url => URL.revokeObjectURL(url));
   111→  gif.finish();
   112→  const gifBytes = gif.bytes();
   113→  const blob = new Blob([gifBytes], { type: 'image/gif' });
   114→  onProgress?.({ stage: 'complete', current: images.length, total: images.length, message: 'Complete!' });
   115→  return blob;
   116→}

   123→  document.body.appendChild(a);
   124→  a.click();
   125→  document.body.removeChild(a);
